## Source growth program

### New candidates discovered

Five previously untracked Korean platform families were screened today: 문피아 (Munpia), 네이버 시리즈 (NAVER SERIES), 리디 (RIDI), 카카오페이지 (KakaoPage), and 조아라 (Joara). This meets the daily minimum of five new source or collection candidates.

### Full audits

**문피아 / Munpia — PASS for link-only discovery; richer adapter deferred.** The current official platform and reader-discovery surface are reachable. Current service terms preserve creator/provider rights and restrict unapproved commercial reuse of service information or provider-owned materials. WebNR therefore admits only the official landing destination plus its own short discovery metadata. No origin HTML/API/search/ranking/chapter/account/payment request is made by the source. Any richer adapter requires an explicitly permitted machine interface plus reproducible robots, cadence, pagination, timeout, provenance, update/deletion, attribution, work-rights, and account-state fixtures.

**네이버 시리즈 / NAVER SERIES — PASS for link-only discovery; richer adapter deferred.** The current official web-novel home exposes recommendations, TOP 100, categories, new and serial works, and paid/free reader flows. NAVER WEBTOON's current service terms apply to the relevant webtoon/web-novel/Series service family, reserve rights in the service, preserve author rights in user postings, and apply separate conditions to paid and age-restricted content. WebNR stores only the first-party discovery link and authored metadata; it does not ingest works, episodes, covers, rankings, ratings, comments, paid content, accounts, or platform catalogs.

**리디 / RIDI — PASS for link-only discovery; automated scraping explicitly outside the admitted capability.** The current first-party web-novel recommendation surface exposes genre, new, best, and keyword-oriented discovery. RIDI's current terms are v5.0, effective 2026-08-20. They reserve rights in company-created content and explicitly restrict unauthorized macros, scripts, bots, scraping, abnormal traffic, unauthorized extraction, and circumvention of technical protections. The WebNR source therefore sends zero runtime origin requests and must not be upgraded into a scraper under this current contract. A richer capability would require a separately and explicitly permitted interface and complete fixtures.

### Deferred candidates

- **카카오페이지 / KakaoPage:** the official platform exposes a current web-novel reader/discovery surface, but this cycle did not recover a sufficiently clean, current, service-specific policy/access contract through the available evidence path. It remains deferred rather than relying on older policy text or inference.
- **조아라 / Joara:** current first-party service and policy routes were identified, but the current agreement surface is not reproducibly inspectable enough in the available path to establish a complete rights/access and machine-interface boundary. It remains deferred.

### Passing integration

Pull request #105 added `Korean Web-Fiction Platforms Starter` with exactly three link-only records: Munpia, NAVER SERIES, and RIDI. The source stores official destination URLs, WebNR-authored descriptions, labels, and rights/access boundaries only. It does not copy or poll story text, episodes, covers, rankings, reviews, comments, profiles, accounts, purchases, or platform catalog data and does not automate login, payments, free-ticket systems, age verification, DRM, captchas, regional restrictions, or other access controls.
